title: D2P Quality Evidence Bundle
description: Collects the test and benchmark reports that serve as evidence for a quality gate over pinned subject revisions (design decision ADR-025). overallState follows the evidence state rule, checked at the semantic level from this document alone (D2P-SEM-110): it is failed if a requiredSuites entry has no reports entry with the same suiteId and suiteVersion, or if any reports entry is failed; otherwise it is inconclusive if any entry is inconclusive or skipped; otherwise it is passed. Incomplete evidence is never passed. reports[].reportId is informative and not resolved by the referential runner.

schemaVersion.description: Full SemVer of the standard release this document was written against.

bundleId.description: Global ID of this evidence bundle (prefix qeb_).

createdAt.description: UTC time at which the bundle was assembled.

gate.description: The gate this evidence is collected for, identified by the validation profile (ID and version) the gate applies: a gate evaluation may list this bundle in 'evidenceRefs' only if its 'profile' equals 'gate' and its 'targetRefs' equal 'subjectRefs' as sets (D2P-REF-007).

subjectRefs.description: Pinned artifact revisions the evidence is about.

requiredSuites.description: Suites (with exact version) the gate requires evidence from. A required suite without a matching reports entry makes overallState failed.

reports.description: One entry per included test run report or benchmark run.

overallState.description: Aggregated state according to the evidence state rule (D2P-SEM-110).

contentDigest.description: Optional digest of this document (d2p-digest-v1, excluding contentDigest).

suitePin.title: Suite pin
suitePin.description: A test suite at an exact version.

evidenceReportEntry.title: Evidence report entry
evidenceReportEntry.description: Summary of one included report, pinned by its contentDigest.

reportId.description: reportId of the included test run report (trr_) or benchmark run (bmr_).

contentDigest.description: contentDigest of the included report as defined by d2p-digest-v1 (computed whether or not the report writes it out).

backend.description: Backend pin of the included report, where it has one.
